title: The price of looking and feeling good
paragraphs: How much do you spend on looking after yourself each month? We all like to look and feel good, so it's nice to spend money on ourselves sometimes! You might spend your hard-earned cash on visiting the hairdresser, a gym membership or pampering yourself with a massage.

When it comes to hair and beauty, the average UK household spends just under 2% of their budget, according to personal finance experts, Nimble Fins. That's about £38 a month if you have an annual salary of £30,000. Areas that were looked at in their survey included toiletries, cosmetics, and related electrical appliances, like hairdryers.

However, it seems that some people spend much more than that. The booking app for all things aesthetic, Pamperbook, carried out a survey in 2022 of 900 UK salons and freelancers. The results found that female clients who use the app spend, on average, £1,000 per month. The survey showed that the most popular treatments were lashes and lip fillers, while customers frequently visited hair salons for a blow dry.

But it's not only women who spend money on beauty. Though men and women visit spas more or less equally, according to the International Spa Association, or ISPA, men spend more on treatments. A national survey in 2019 found that male participants spend more on massages and facials per year than women – £501 to £445. Garrett Mersberger, head of the ISPA, said: "Men are more aware that it's not just a thing I go to to get pampered. It's an actual lifestyle choice with benefits to my body, my wellness."
Whether you tend to spend money on these things or not, it can certainly feel good to treat yourself every now and then!

vocabulary.entry: hard-earned /ˌhɑːd ˈɜːnd/ adj. 辛苦赚来的

vocabulary.entry: hairdresser /ˈheədresə(r)/ n. 理发师；美发师

vocabulary.translation: 我下班后约了理发师。

vocabulary.translation: 会员费每月20英镑。

vocabulary.example: My grandmother loves to pamper her grandchildren.
vocabulary.translation: 我奶奶特别疼爱孙辈。

vocabulary.entry: massage /ˈmæsɑːʒ/ n. 按摩
vocabulary.example: A back massage can help relieve stress.
vocabulary.translation: 背部按摩有助于缓解压力。

vocabulary.entry: household /ˈhaʊshəʊld/ n. 家庭；一家人
vocabulary.example: Most households have a computer these days.

vocabulary.entry: budget /ˈbʌdʒɪt/ n. 预算

vocabulary.entry: finance /ˈfaɪnæns/ n. 财务；金融【书面词汇】

vocabulary.translation: 他是个人理财与投资专家。

vocabulary.entry: annual /ˈænjuəl/ adj. 年度的；每年的

vocabulary.entry: salary /ˈsæləri/ n. 薪水；年薪

vocabulary.entry: toiletries /ˈtɔɪlətriz/ n. 洗漱用品；洗护用品【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: The hotel provides free shampoo and other toiletries.

vocabulary.entry: cosmetics /kɒzˈmetɪks/ n. 化妆品
vocabulary.example: She sells organic cosmetics online.
vocabulary.translation: 她在网上售卖有机化妆品。

vocabulary.entry: appliance /əˈplaɪəns/ n. 电器；器具【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: The shop sells a wide range of electrical appliances.
vocabulary.translation: 这家商店售卖各类电器。

vocabulary.entry: hairdryer /ˈheədraɪə(r)/ n. 吹风机
vocabulary.example: Don’t forget to pack a hairdryer for the trip.
vocabulary.translation: 旅行别忘了带吹风机。

vocabulary.entry: aesthetic /iːsˈθetɪk/ adj. 美容的；审美的【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: The clinic offers a variety of aesthetic procedures.
vocabulary.translation: 这家诊所提供多种美容项目。

vocabulary.entry: salon /ˈsælɒn/ n. 美容院；美发店
vocabulary.example: She works as a stylist in a beauty salon.
vocabulary.translation: 她在一家美容院做造型师。

vocabulary.entry: freelancer /ˈfriːlɑːnsə(r)/ n. 自由职业者【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: Many beauty therapists work as freelancers.
vocabulary.translation: 很多美容师是自由职业者。

vocabulary.entry: client /ˈklaɪənt/ n. 客户；顾客

vocabulary.translation: 这家美容院有很多老顾客。

vocabulary.entry: treatment /ˈtriːtmənt/ n. 护理；理疗
vocabulary.example: This facial treatment is good for dry skin.
vocabulary.translation: 这款面部护理适合干性皮肤。

vocabulary.entry: lash /læʃ/ n. 睫毛
vocabulary.example: She has long, thick lashes.
vocabulary.translation: 她有着又长又密的睫毛。

vocabulary.entry: filler /ˈfɪlə(r)/ n. 美容填充剂【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: Lip fillers are one of the most popular cosmetic treatments.
vocabulary.translation: 丰唇填充是最受欢迎的美容项目之一。

vocabulary.entry: blow dry /ˈbləʊ draɪ/ n. 吹风造型
vocabulary.example: She went to the salon for a cut and blow dry.
vocabulary.translation: 她去理发店剪发并做了吹风造型。

vocabulary.entry: spa /spɑː/ n. 水疗中心
vocabulary.example: We spent the day relaxing at a luxury spa.
vocabulary.translation: 我们在豪华水疗中心放松了一整天。

vocabulary.entry: participant /pɑːˈtɪsɪpənt/ n. 参与者【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: All participants in the survey were adults.
vocabulary.translation: 调查的所有参与者都是成年人。

vocabulary.entry: facial /ˈfeɪʃl/ n. 面部护理
vocabulary.example: I treat myself to a facial once a month.
vocabulary.translation: 我每月犒劳自己做一次面部护理。

vocabulary.entry: wellness /ˈwelnes/ n. 健康；养生【书面词汇】
vocabulary.example: The hotel offers fitness and wellness facilities.
vocabulary.translation: 这家酒店配有健身和养生设施。

vocabulary.entry: treat /triːt/ v. 犒劳；款待
vocabulary.example: I’m going to treat myself to a nice dinner tonight.
vocabulary.translation: 今晚我要好好犒劳自己吃顿大餐。
